source.name: South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks — Draw Statistics (2026 first application period)

notes: GFP 2026 limited-draw results, first application period only, from GFP's Draw Statistics tool (linked from https://gfp.sd.gov/draw-stats/; per license: 'Draw Results' table by preference pool and 'Draw Preference Breakdown' table by preference-point level). One row = one GFP license (season + unit + license type). huntCode = '<season prefix>-<GFP license code>'. Prefixes printed by GFP: AEE, BHE, PRE, CEE, CUE, CAE (elk), BHS, CBS (sheep), BHD, CUD (deer), ESD, WSD (special buck), ADNP, ARNP (nonresident archery). Prefixes added here for uniqueness (not GFP codes): WRD West River deer, ERD East River deer, MZD muzzleloader deer, NWR refuge deer, ERNL East River nonresident landowner-own-land, APD/APA archery access permits, PRA prairie firearms antelope, CUA Custer State Park antelope. unit = GFP license code minus the 2-digit license type (e.g. 02A01 -> unit 02A, type 01; H2B23 -> H2B; BH252 -> BH2; ST1 = statewide). A trailing P on the type (03P, 13P, 19P) = valid on private land only. DrawStat.tags = all licenses issued in the first draw plus any left after the last pool (sum of 'Licenses Issued' over that residency's first-choice pools + the last pool's 'Remaining Licenses'). applicants = first-choice applicants = total of the residency's Preference Breakdown tables (Landowner + Resident Non Landowner for residents). successPct = first-choice successful / first-choice applicants x 100, computed here (GFP prints no percentage). Checked for every row: point-level rows sum to the printed totals, and first-choice successful equals licenses issued across the pools. pools (residents only, where GFP runs a landowner-preference pool): 'Landowner preference' and 'Resident non-landowner' applicants/success; pool tags null. pointLines: per preference-point level, applicants and successful from the Preference Breakdown — resident = 'Resident Non Landowner' (or 'Resident' when there is no landowner pool), nonresident = 'Non Resident'; levels with 0 applicants dropped. South Dakota's draw is a random draw in preference pools with cubed points (see sd-research.md), so no minPoints is given. nonresident null = no nonresident licenses in that draw (East River, Muzzleloader, Custer State Park deer, elk, sheep, and resident-only access permits are resident-only). Second-choice applicants and the 2nd-4th draws / leftovers are not counted. Weapon: firearm seasons stored as 'rifle'; refuge deer and sheep have no weapon set (refuge units vary; Lacreek is muzzleloader-only). Not included: Municipal Archery Deer (city management hunts), turkey, bison, mountain lion, paddlefish, the Returned Deer re-issue phase. Special Antelope has no 2026 statistics posted (latest 2025). MTNGOAT: Black Hills mountain goat season is closed (GFP mountain-goat page); last draw statistics are 2022, so no rows.
